title: CogVLM: Visual Expert for Pretrained Language Models
description: Most multimodal LLMs inject visual features via cross-attention or prefix tokens, but this forces the language model to use the same weights for both text and vision — a poor inductive bias. CogVLM adds a separate "visual expert" — trainable Q, K, V projections in each transformer layer for visual tokens — while freezing the LLM. Achieves state-of-the-art on 17 benchmarks.
authors: Wang, Chen, Dong, Liu, Wang, Bao, Nie, Tang, Zhou, Li, et al. (Zhipu AI / Tsinghua)
